facts.raw_span: A 29-year-old Chinese male patient
no underlying disease
hospitalized twice for injuries from a car accident
open abdominal injury
emergency surgery and discharge after 5 days
re-admitted due to persistent lower abdominal pain
Temperature 36.8°C
total abdominal tenderness, especially in lower abdomen, with rebound pain and muscle tension
Temperature rose to 39.3°C
WBC 16.62 x109/L, neutrophils 87.80%
CT scan showed intestinal perforation, peritonitis, high density shadow in ascending colon, and thickening/swelling of ascending colon and ileum segments
Blood culture: Positive in bilateral anaerobic bottles
